newsitem.title: UK: UK watchdog says Tory broadcast broke no codes.
newsitem.headline: UK watchdog says Tory broadcast broke no codes.

text.p: Britain's television watchdog on Monday said a Conservative Party political broadcast did not breach any regulatory codes, although nine viewers found the broadcast offensive.

The Conservative Party broadcast, aired on January 21, portrayed a woman voter reacting in horror to imaginary adverse news stories about a future Labour government. The broadcast was filmed in black and white, but at the end a red tear rolled down the woman's face.
The Conservatives have also been using the red tears image in its poster advertising campaign.
The ITC said the broadcast did not infringe any codes regarding taste and decency.
